_comment: Unit Roadmap spec. Unit title, phase and section titles come from courses/chemistry/DECISIONS.md; do not add them here. 'measured' must agree with DECISIONS.md 'Assessment shape'. Standards follow reports/chem-ohio-standards-verification.md §5 (CONFIRMED rows as main; inference-only, conditional and VIP-for-a-NONE-section rows as support only); key wording from §4.
big_idea: An element's place on the periodic table predicts how it behaves. Students describe **trends** in size, ionization energy and electronegativity, and explain them with nuclear charge and shielding.

ican: I can **locate** periods, groups, and named families.
I can **explain** why a group's elements behave alike.
I can **locate** metals, nonmetals, and metalloids.
I can **classify** an element by its properties.
I can **describe** the atomic radius trend.
I can **compare** an ion's size with its atom's.
I can **describe** the trend in each property.
I can **find** valence electrons from ionization-energy jumps.
I can **explain** trends with nuclear charge and shielding.
I can **justify** which of two atoms is larger.
I can **predict** an ion's charge from its group.
I can **write** the symbol and configuration of an ion.

standards_source: Ohio's Learning Standards for Science (adopted 2018) · Chemistry
standards_key: evolution of atomic models/theory; electrons; electron configurations.
ionic and polar/covalent bonds; metallic bonding also introduced.
measured: Daily practice that builds from basic to multi-step problems
One end-of-unit quiz in place of a unit test
